Vendored for Cortex offline enterprise deployments.

Reason:
Some target Codex and Claude environments cannot access the internet at
runtime. The Frontend Slides skill therefore carries its upstream skill
files and the full Beautiful HTML Templates library as source assets.

Sources:
- frontend-slides: https://github.com/zarazhangrui/frontend-slides
- beautiful-html-templates: https://github.com/zarazhangrui/beautiful-html-templates

Licenses:
Both upstream repositories include MIT LICENSE files. Preserve those
files and attribution when refreshing this vendor payload.

Refresh rule:
Update vendored files in Cortex source, validate, commit, then redeploy
native packages. Do not make generated Codex or Claude packages the
source of truth.

Packaging note:
Keep frontend-slides/bold-template-pack/ and frontend-slides/scripts/
because the upstream Frontend Slides skill references those top-level
paths directly. The upstream repository also packaged duplicate copies
under frontend-slides/plugins/frontend-slides/skills/frontend-slides/.
Those nested plugin packaging files are pruned when they are byte-for-byte
duplicates of the preserved top-level assets.

Font note:
Template font binaries are not present in the upstream template repos.
Cortex carries template-referenced Google Fonts separately under
../assets/fonts/ so offline decks can preserve the template visual
identity without fetching fonts from Google at runtime. Referenced fonts
that are not available through the Google Fonts CSS API are documented
in ../assets/fonts/FONT-SOURCES.md and must not be added from another
CDN until license and provenance are verified.
